overall: The AG found the Roads Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by using the unexplained acronym "TRRP" in a meeting notice, but found the "Other Business" heading compliant; no further relief was ordered because the Subcommittee had apologized and pledged to comply.

allegations.summary: Notice topic 'Discussion regarding TRRP Policy' used an acronym the public would not understand, so the notice was not specific enough.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the acronym, "TRRP," which stands for "Temporary Repair to Private Roads Policy," is not widely understood by members of the public who are unfamiliar with the Subcommittee's work.

allegations.summary: The general agenda heading 'Other Business' in the same notice was alleged to be insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: Similarly, here, because the Subcommittee listed more specific topics below the general heading, "Other Business," we find that this group of topics is sufficiently detailed, in compliance with the law.
